description: Generate an HOTP code (RFC 4226) for a given counter value from a base32-encoded shared secret. Supports 6-8 digit codes and SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 (SHA-1 is the default per the RFC). The secret is never stored, only used for this one HMAC computation.

secret.description: The base32-encoded shared secret (RFC 4648, case-insensitive, padding optional)

name: generate_hotp
